claims.assertion: Mari distinguishes smaller, humanoid Dracos from Alpha Draconians, a separate reptilian species divided into genetically similar positive and negative factions that often fight.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says their ethics and cultures differ sharply.

claims.assertion: Mari says negative Alpha Draconians ally with Dracos and other invasive groups, while positive factions cooperate especially with the Urmah.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes the negative alliance as historical.

claims.assertion: Mari describes Alpha Draconians as giant, winged, fire-breathing, strongly telepathic beings; their fire-breathing capacity is limited by supply and hydration.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: appearance, homeworld and military details omitted
